Container.Name: postgres17_sure
Container.Overview:
PostgreSQL 17 database for Sure, pre-configured to work with the Sure and Sure-Worker templates. Official PostgreSQL 17 image with the pgvector extension included (optional, used by Sure's AI document search).
Full step-by-step guide: https://github.com/Yusseiin/unraid-templates/blob/main/docs/sure-setup.md
BEFORE INSTALLING, create the shared network once from the Unraid terminal (the container will not start without it):
docker network create sure-net
DO NOT RENAME this container: Sure and Sure-Worker connect to it by the name "postgres17_sure". No port is exposed to your LAN; only containers on sure-net can reach it.
Set a strong Database Password (e.g. openssl rand -hex 24) and use the same password in Sure and Sure-Worker. The user, password and database are only created the FIRST time the container starts with an empty data folder: changing them later here has no effect.
Install order: postgres17_sure, redis_sure, Sure, Sure-Worker.
Major version upgrades (e.g. 17 to 18) are not automatic: keep the pg17 tag and back up the data folder.
Container.Requires: The Docker network "sure-net" (create it with: docker network create sure-net).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: PostgreSQL data folder. Back it up together with the Sure storage folder.

Config.Name: Database Name
Config.Description: Database created on first start. Must match Database Name in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Database User
Config.Description: User created on first start. Must match Database User in Sure and Sure-Worker.

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: Required. Password set on first start (e.g. openssl rand -hex 24). Must match Database Password in Sure and Sure-Worker.
